summary: Adobe Inc. filed an 8-K reporting items 5.02 and 5.07, covering shareholder approval at the April 15, 2026 Annual Meeting to amend the 2019 Equity Incentive Plan by adding 12 million shares to the reserve. The filing also details the vote outcomes for director elections and other routine proposals with no forced departures or sudden managerial changes. This is a routine current report on standard compensation plan amendments and shareholder votes, not a special situation.
